name: 会話のプライバシー案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0004「会話のプライバシー案内」.
Priority: Image1 ORIGINAL source governs padlock glyph anatomy, proportions, optical weight, alignment and fine notice details; Image2 our mock is SECONDARY for localized Japanese copy and overall compact structure only. Image3 approved styling: white rounded surfaces, fine neutral outlines and restrained elevation.
One compact information notice card on pure white canvas. Card white, fine neutral border, modest rounded corners, very soft downward shadow. Preserve logical322x84px card within390x100px component proportions. Small padlock aligned at left of first text line, body and link in a clean column to its right. Use ORIGINAL's compact filled padlock silhouette with curved shackle, adapted to slate #526173; do not copy the mock's oversized crude outline padlock. Keep the lock small and familiar, not inside a colored circle.
Text verbatim as TWO lines, body Meiryo Regular logical12px/16px tracking0:
メッセージと通話は暗号化されます。
この会話の参加者だけが閲覧できます。
Below, left aligned to body:「詳しく見る」Meiryo Bold12px/16px, forest green #1F6444. Body #1D1D1D.
Original pale yellow groups an informational privacy note, not an error/warning. Adapt that grouping to the white outlined card with padlock and green secondary link; omit yellow/mint fill. No warning triangle, invented guarantee, encryption badge, extra security text, new status, arrow or primary button. No brand gradient required for a small text link.
Output landscape3:1, ONE readable compact notice centered with modest pure-white margins. Keep line wrapping and hierarchy, all characters complete. No full phone, chat wallpaper, header, duplicated notice, captions or English. This raster is only a design candidate; preserve the actual product wording without embellishment.
reviewNotes: 原画像が鍵の形状と細部の主参照。モックの大きな輪郭鍵を原画像由来の小さな塗り鍵へ修正。元の淡黄色は情報グループであり警告ではないため白カード・中立枠へ適応し、詳しく見るを森林緑に統一。出力を目視し、日本語2行・リンク・鍵・白面・細枠・影・欠落なしを確認。実暗号化、ネイティブ編集、フォント計測・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
